Team —

Finalizing a few items for the launch QBR and day-of ops. Goal: quick signoffs so enablement docs and the support rota can be locked by end of Tuesday. High-level asks below: 

1) Enablement micro-scripts: attached is v3 (enablement-microscripts-v3.docx). These are the 30–60s canned walkthroughs for CS/AE to use in trial handoffs. Please review for accuracy and any missing edge cases.

2) Pricing redlines and exceptions: Ben, I included the pricing-exceptions-v2.csv with the known negotiated exceptions we may need to honor for two customers during ramp. Need confirmation on whether we can approve on pilot terms or if legal/procurement needs to sign off.

3) Weekend triage hotline: proposing a lightweight rota (launch-weekend-triage-rota.xlsx). We need an on-call escalation ladder and SRE routing confirmation (cc'd external SRE contact below).

Timeline:
- Review and comments by EOD Monday (5/24)
- Final signoff by leadership in this thread by noon PDT Tuesday (5/25)

Please reply with either "approve" or the minimal changes required. If you need a short sync, I can host a 20-minute standup Monday 10:30 PDT.

Thanks —
Grace

Head of GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

Grace —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick replies inline and a few concrete suggestions below.

- Enablement micro-scripts: skimmed v3. Great tight scripts; two suggested edits: add a "declining quota" line for trial users (script 2) and include a one-liner to escalate to SRE for intermittent latency reports. I pasted the suggested 1-liners at the end of this message.

- Pricing exceptions: Ben — can you confirm if the exceptions in the CSV require a contract amendment? If so, please share the minimal amendment language so Legal can fast-track. If not, can we get an approval matrix: who can approve up to X%/amount?

- Triage rota: I'm comfortable with the proposed weekend rota but request that we have a single hotline number with automatic forwarding to the on-call SRE then to Support L2 if SRE unavailable. SRE Oncall, can you confirm the forwarding windows and whether the hotline can be covered by our partner SRE for the first 48 hours post-launch?

Proposed micro-script additions (one-liners):
- For trial users seeing "cold start" latency: "We're aware some users may see temporary slowdowns; we're on it — can you share the example prompt and timestamp so our team can investigate?"
- For quota/limits: "If you hit a token limit, we can schedule a quick call to review your usage pattern and propose a tuned plan or guardrails."

I can host a 20-minute sync Monday 10:30 PDT if folks prefer to walk through. Otherwise, I'll collect approvals here and push the final artifacts to Drive.

-Lukas
